full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photographic image shows a small dark ship at sea beneath an immense billowing storm cloud. The background horizon is low and pale on the far left, where mist dissolves the boundary between water and sky. Across most of the upper frame, a heavy cloud mass swells from the right and hangs over the vessel. Its underside is nearly black, while lighter gray folds curl along the lower edge and make the vapor appear dense and turbulent. The ship sits left of center near the horizon, rendered as a narrow dark silhouette with a low hull and a few upright masts or posts. A faint line of light separates it from the shadowed water below. The foreground sea is rough and dark, with irregular bright patches picking out wave crests as they roll toward the lower edge. Near the lower-left corner, a strip of shore or darker ground interrupts the water, and a tiny upright mark stands against the distant haze. The contrast of scale is severe: the vessel occupies only a small fraction of the frame while the cloud fills the sky and presses close to the surface. Fine photographic grain and subtle tonal gradations keep the cloud from becoming a flat black shape; tiny highlights along water and vapor give it physical depth. The viewpoint is low, approximately level with the sea, emphasizing the width of the weather system. Light enters diffusely from the pale left horizon, tracing the cloud's outer folds and wave tips while leaving the right side in deep charcoal. The overall composition is ominous and monumental, using nearly monochrome value, rough water texture, and a tiny isolated silhouette to convey the force of the approaching storm.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白摄影画面呈现一艘小黑船在海上，头顶是巨大翻腾的风暴云。背景地平线在最左侧低而浅，雾气使水天边界模糊。厚重云团从右方鼓起，悬在船上，占据上半幅大部分。云底近乎黑色，较浅的灰色褶皱沿下缘卷曲，使云汽显得密实而汹涌。船在中央偏左、靠近地平线的位置，是一道细窄的深色剪影，低矮船体上有几根直立桅杆或支柱。一条淡淡的亮线把它同下方暗水分开。前景海面粗糙而深暗，不规则亮斑标出向下缘滚来的浪尖。左下角附近，一小条海岸或更暗的地面打断水面，一处微小直立的痕迹立在远处薄雾前。尺度对比非常强烈：船只占画面极小一部分，云团却填满天空并压向水面。细摄影颗粒和微妙的明度过渡使云层不会变成平坦黑块；水与云汽上的小亮点赋予它实体纵深。视点较低，大致与海面平齐，突出天气系统的宽度。光从左侧浅色地平线漫散进入，勾出云层外缘褶皱和浪尖，右侧仍沉在深炭色中。整体构图不祥而宏大，以近乎单色的明度、粗粝水纹和细小孤立剪影传达逼近风暴的力量。
style_prompt_en: The photographic image relies on a full grayscale range, from pale mist and silver highlights to dense charcoal black. Large dark masses gather above or beside small sharply legible silhouettes, creating a strong contrast of scale. Fine grain and smooth but complex tonal transitions preserve texture within deep shadow, while scattered bright edges pick out turbulent or weathered surfaces. A low viewing angle and wide atmospheric span create monumentality without saturated color. Light is diffuse from one open side, glazing ridges and leaving the opposite areas heavy and dark. Foreground textures are rougher and clearer, while distance dissolves gradually into haze. The overall effect is austere and dramatic, using value structure, weathered detail, and spatial falloff to carry emotion.
style_prompt_zh: 摄影画面依靠完整的灰阶，从浅色雾气和银色亮点延伸到浓密炭黑。大片深色体块聚在细小却清楚的剪影上方或旁边，形成强烈尺度对比。细颗粒与平滑而复杂的明度过渡在深影中保留肌理，零散亮边则挑出翻动或风化的表面。低视点和宽广的空气跨度不借饱和色彩也能建立宏大感。光从一侧开放区域漫散而来，擦亮凸脊，让对侧区域厚重幽暗。前景纹理更粗、更清楚，远处则逐步溶入雾气。整体效果简峻而戏剧化，以明度结构、风化细节和空间衰减承载情绪。
theme_en: A small dark ship beneath a vast billowing storm cloud
theme_zh: 一艘小黑船位于巨大翻腾的风暴云下
name: Albert Renger-Patzsch
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
